snippet.title: Nion Forge Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954090/Nion_Forge/

Build your own flying vehicles in this action-packed roguelike dystopia. 

Discover a neon-lit dystopia full of exciting challenges in Nion Forge - the action-packed cyberpunk shoot 'em up! Here you have the opportunity to build your own ship and fight above the dystopian streets as you face off against hordes of enemies.

Be surprised by our unique upgrades and weapons that make every playthrough a new experience.
Key Features

+ Built on a survorlike experience
+ Unique upgrades with every new run
+ Customizable player ships based on unlockable modules
+ Formidable boss fights
